description: Renewable Energy Capacity in 2030 is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). IRENA Copyright Info: Material in this publication may be freely used, shared, copied, reproduced, printed and/or stored, provided that all such material is clearly attributed to IRENA and bears a notation that it is subject to copyright (© IRENA 2018). Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Renewable & Other Fuels. Its keywords are Capacity, IRENA. The portal shows 2026-06-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
